_about.purpose: Twenty reports the prompts are never tuned against. Run once, at the end, and record the result in the README whatever it turns out to be.
_about.rule: If you look at these while tuning, they stop being a holdout and this file is worthless. Written 2026-08-14, before any prompt tuning began.
_about.why_this_beats_data_provenance: The obvious objection to an authored dataset is that the system was tuned until it passed its own demo. A holdout tests exactly that. It is a stronger answer than sourcing reports externally, which cannot be done anyway: no public dataset contains several free-text descriptions of one event by different reporters, because intake operators normalise that away at collection.

adversarial_cases.no_shared_vocabulary: A real 4-report cluster (bike stripping at the rack) where the four reporters share almost no words. Must be found. This is the premise under harder conditions than the seed set.
adversarial_cases.heavy_shared_vocabulary: Four reports that all talk about parked cars on the same street but describe four unrelated incidents. Must NOT be escalated as one situation. This is the failure mode a keyword or threshold approach falls into.

_about.expectations: `_expect` is 'silent', 'decline', or 'alert_window' (exactly one alert across the reports so tagged). `_group` names the designed case.

reports.text: The recycling truck clipped our wheelie bin again and the lid is hanging off.
Kids have been climbing on the substation fence after school. Somebody is going to get hurt.
Water butt has sprung a leak, there is a puddle right across the path now.
Post came for a house that was demolished two years ago. Third time this month.
Someone set off a car alarm at midnight and nobody came out to it for twenty minutes.
The security light at the back has started coming on in broad daylight.
There is a shopping trolley in the hedge at the bottom of the road.
Scaffolding went up next door without any notice and it is partly over the pavement.
Came down to find my back wheel gone and the frame still chained up.
Somebody has had the saddle and seatpost off mine overnight. Lock was untouched.
There are bits of a bike left by the stands, brake cables cut and hanging.
Mine has been stripped for parts where it stood. Only the frame is left on the rail.
A parked car on Sycamore Row has a flat tyre and has been sat on it for days.
Someone reversed into a parked car on Sycamore Row and drove off without leaving a note.
A parked car on Sycamore Row is blocking the dropped kerb so the pushchair cannot get past.
The parked car on Sycamore Row outside number forty has had its window left wide open all evening.
Hedge on the corner has grown right out over the path, you have to step into the road.
Someone has been dumping grass cuttings behind the compost bins.
Delivery vans keep mounting the verge to turn and it is churned to mud.
There was a lot of shouting outside around ten but it had stopped by the time I looked.
